description: Newest job postings ('projects') from Wantedly's public projects API, mostly Japanese employers: title, company name, location, what they look for (e.g. remote OK), publish time, page link. Pay and description are not returned. Text is in the language the employer wrote it, usually Japanese. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_weworkremotely when you need newest remote job postings from We Work Remotely's public; jobs_governmentjobs when you need US public-sector job postings from GovernmentJobs.com. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: jobs_wantedly
title: Newest job postings from Wantedly's public projects API
